cases.question: How many annual leave days do full-time employees receive?
cases.answer: 根据知识库资料：Full-time employees receive 18 working days of annual leave per calendar year.

cases.question: How long is the probation period for new employees?
cases.answer: 根据知识库资料：New employees have a three-month probation period.

cases.question: How many remote work days per week are allowed after manager approval?
cases.answer: 根据知识库资料：Employees may work remotely up to two days per week after their manager approves a recurring schedule.

cases.question: What is the yearly learning budget for a full-time employee?
cases.answer: 根据知识库资料：Each full-time employee has a yearly learning budget of 1200 currency units.

cases.question: Which account requires multi-factor authentication?
cases.answer: 根据知识库资料：All staff must enable multi-factor authentication on the corporate identity account.

cases.question: How often must owners review production access?
cases.answer: 根据知识库资料：Application owners review production access every 90 days.

cases.question: Within how long must a suspected security incident be reported?
cases.answer: 根据知识库资料：A suspected security incident must be reported to the security duty channel within 30 minutes of discovery.

cases.question: What classification applies to documents with customer identifiers?
cases.answer: 根据知识库资料：Documents containing customer identifiers are classified Confidential.

cases.question: On which days are routine production deployments scheduled?
cases.answer: 根据知识库资料：Routine production deployments run on Tuesday and Thursday between 10:00 and 16:00 local time.

cases.question: What error-rate condition triggers a rollback?
cases.answer: 根据知识库资料：If the error rate exceeds five percent for ten consecutive minutes after a release, the release owner starts rollback.

cases.question: When does the primary on-call engineer hand off?
cases.answer: 根据知识库资料：The primary on-call engineer hands off at 09:00 every Monday.

cases.question: At what time are PostgreSQL backups checked each morning?
cases.answer: 根据知识库资料：PostgreSQL backups are checked every morning at 08:00.

cases.question: What purchase amount requires department head and Finance approval?
cases.answer: 根据知识库资料：Purchases above 5000 currency units require approval from the department head and Finance before an order is placed.

cases.question: What must a supplier processing customer data complete before contract signature?
cases.answer: 根据知识库资料：Any supplier that will process customer data must complete a security review before contract signature.

cases.question: How long are signed supplier contracts retained after expiry?
cases.answer: 根据知识库资料：Signed supplier contracts are stored in the legal repository for seven years after expiry.

cases.question: Within how many days must approved business expenses be submitted?
cases.answer: 根据知识库资料：Approved business expenses must be submitted within 45 days of purchase with an itemized receipt.

cases.question: What is the first human response target for priority-one support tickets?
cases.answer: 根据知识库资料：Priority-one support tickets receive a first human response within 15 minutes.

cases.question: When does support escalate an unresolved priority-one issue to engineering?
cases.answer: 根据知识库资料：If a priority-one issue remains unresolved after 60 minutes, the support lead escalates to the on-call engineering lead.

cases.question: How often are customers updated during a priority-one incident?
cases.answer: 根据知识库资料：During a priority-one incident, support sends affected customers an update every 30 minutes until mitigation is complete.

cases.question: When is the customer satisfaction survey sent after ticket closure?
cases.answer: 根据知识库资料：A customer satisfaction survey is sent 24 hours after a support ticket is closed.

cases.question: What is the data retention period for customer call recordings?
cases.answer: 根据知识库资料：The standard does not set a retention period for recordings.

cases.question: How many paid holidays do independent contractors receive?
